ratios.facility: Credit Facility (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement)

parsed.notes: The leverage ratio is a debt-to-capitalization percentage, not a debt/EBITDA multiple. Values are in percent: actual 15.2% against a maximum of 60%. The Credit Facility also has dollar-based covenants, which are not ratios and so are not listed: minimum tangible net worth (requirement > $3,576,606K, actual $5,008,077K) and investments other than permitted investments (limit < $1,527,423K, actual $59,423K). The debt-to-capital (26.8%) and net debt-to-capital (17.1%) figures are non-covenant performance measures and are excluded, as are the leverage-based pricing grid and fee ratios.
